---
title: "BGP Policy"
---

# BGP Policy

The eBGP triangle accepts every prefix on every session. This chapter keeps the triangle and adds three controls: a prefix-list that drops a leak, a local preference that picks an exit, and a community that tells the far AS not to readvertise.

Use the eBGP lab's ASNs and links. Originate one extra prefix on r-frr, `203.0.113.0/24`, which is documentation space and stands in for a prefix you do not own.

## Learning goals

By the end of this chapter you can:

- Drop a prefix on the way into cEOS
- Prefer one exit with local preference on FRR
- Tag a prefix with `no-export` and watch it stop at the next AS
- Read the policy and the route, not just the session state

## cEOS, inbound filter toward FRR

```text
ip prefix-list FROM-FRR seq 10 deny 203.0.113.0/24
ip prefix-list FROM-FRR seq 20 permit 0.0.0.0/0 le 32
router bgp 65002
   neighbor 10.1.12.1 prefix-list FROM-FRR in
```

`203.0.113.0/24` must be on an interface or a static on r-frr or BGP will not originate it. A blackhole static is enough:

```text
ip route 203.0.113.0/24 Null0
router bgp 65001
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 203.0.113.0/24
```

## FRR, prefer the direct cEOS exit

You have two ways to reach `172.16.2.1/32`: direct from 65002, and via 65003. Set local preference on the cEOS neighbour:

```text
route-map PREFER-CEOS permit 10
 set local-preference 200
router bgp 65001
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  neighbor 10.1.12.2 route-map PREFER-CEOS in
```

## no-export

On r-ceos, toward r-srl only, attach the well-known community to its own LAN:

```text
route-map TAG-NO-EXPORT permit 10
   match ip address prefix-list OWN
   set community no-export
ip prefix-list OWN seq 10 permit 172.16.2.1/32
router bgp 65002
   neighbor 10.1.23.2 route-map TAG-NO-EXPORT out
   neighbor 10.1.23.2 send-community
```

r-srl may install the prefix. r-srl must not send it on to r-frr. Confirm on r-frr that the only path for `172.16.2.1/32` is the direct session, not `65003 65002`.

## Verify

```bash
docker exec clab-ebgp-r-ceos Cli -c "show ip bgp 203.0.113.0/24"
docker exec clab-ebgp-r-frr vtysh -c "show ip bgp 172.16.2.1/32"
docker exec clab-ebgp-r-srl sr_cli "show network-instance default route-table ipv4-unicast prefix 172.16.2.1/32"
```

### Predict

- cEOS has no path for `203.0.113.0/24`.
- FRR's best path to `172.16.2.1/32` has local preference 200 and neighbour 10.1.12.2.
- After `no-export`, r-frr does not learn `172.16.2.1/32` from r-srl.

## Drill

Change the prefix-list to `permit 203.0.113.0/24` and `deny` everything else by deleting sequence 20. You just blackholed the legitimate LAN. Put sequence 20 back. Write one sentence on why a prefix-list without a later permit is a lockout.
